gameDescriptionHtml:
The hero’s journey of a pig who refuses to become a sausage!

There once was a peaceful farm, where lazy pigs lived behind a low fence.

Until, one day, they smashed the fence and made their great escape!

Pigs make the best sausages!
Pipes shooting fire, freezers, saw blades, conveyor belts! A variety of devices await the pigs.

Help our boy pig avoid becoming a sausage.

Challenging puzzles and tricky platforming!
Machines that recognize cutting lines, lift chases, and relentless butchers! Solve dangerous puzzles inside the sausage factory.

A grand orchestral soundtrack!
Escape the terrifying and brutal sausage factory to the tune of a grand orchestral soundtrack tailor-made for the story of Pig Romance!
